top_actors.name: Ibero-American General Secretariat
top_actors.justification: The Ibero-American General Secretariat is central to the XXVIII Ibero-American Summit, serving as the main coordinating body for the summit's initiatives, decisions, and political dialogue among member states. Its prominence and role in organizing and facilitating the summit make it highly relevant.

top_actors.name: Community of Latin American and Caribbean States
top_actors.justification: The Community of Latin American and Caribbean States is an important regional political actor with influence in multilateral dialogues in the region. While relevant, its direct role in the Ibero-American Summit context is less prominent compared to the Ibero-American General Secretariat.
